rule_wording.line: Policy AP-2027.1
Policy AP-2027.1 · Priya Raman
NF-1.5	Northfield returns a technical acknowledgment to an order acknowledgment · a quantity change is accepted only on a matching order change
rule_wording.catalogue: Northfield returns a technical acknowledgment (997) to an acknowledgment or change response and sends no business acceptance; a quantity change is accepted only on a matching order change

rule_wording.line: NF-1.6	Change requests go to the buyer, who issues the order change · answer within 24 hours
rule_wording.catalogue: Change requests go to the buyer, who issues the order change; answer an order change within 24 hours of the latest change

rule_wording.line: NF-2.1	No backorders · cancel the remainder and report the shipped quantity
rule_wording.catalogue: No backorders: a short line is cancelled and the shipped quantity reported

rule_wording.line: NF-3.2	Collect: routing request by 11:00 DC local, two business days before ready
rule_wording.catalogue: Collect freight: routing request by 11:00 DC local time, two business days before the ready date

rule_wording.line: NF-3.3	Northfield returns routing instructions with carrier and pickup window
rule_wording.catalogue: Northfield returns routing instructions with the carrier and pickup window

rule_wording.line: NF-4.1	GS1-128 labels · no SSCC reuse within 18 months
rule_wording.catalogue: GS1-128 label on every carton; an SSCC is not reused within 18 months

rule_wording.line: NF-7.8	Invoice bills the shipped quantity at the accepted PO price, per line
rule_wording.catalogue: The invoice bills the shipped quantity at the accepted PO price; an invoice that bills more is held

rule_wording.line: ALLOCATION POLICY AP-2027.1
NF-4.5	Ship notice matches the shipment carton for carton	Claim
rule_wording.catalogue: The ship notice matches the shipment carton for carton

rule_wording.line: NF-5.3	On a sealed shipper-load-and-count trailer, the receiving count stands unless the supplier proves the carton was loaded: a load tally or load scan by SSC
rule_wording.catalogue: On a sealed trailer the receiving count stands unless the supplier proves the carton was loaded with a load scan or a load tally by SSCC; the delivery receipt proves the seal, not the count

rule_wording.line: NF-5.5	Northfield may correct a receipt after investigation with a revised receiving advice; a deduction reversal alone does not change the receipt	Claim
rule_wording.catalogue: A receipt changes only through a revised receiving advice; a deduction reversal alone does not change it

rule_wording.line: NF-7.3	Dispute within 60 days of the remittance date, once per deduction, through the deduction case	Claim, Vet
rule_wording.catalogue: Dispute once per deduction, within 60 days of the remittance date, in the deduction case

rule_wording.line: NF-7.4	Required evidence · shortage: bill of lading with seal, proof of delivery, load tally or load scan by SSCC · ship notice charges: transmission timestamps
rule_wording.catalogue: Shortage evidence: bill of lading with seal, proof of delivery, and a load scan or load tally by SSCC

rule_wording.line: NF-7.5	A dispute without the required evidence is charged ID01 and is not reviewed	Claim, Vet
rule_wording.catalogue: A dispute without the required evidence is not reviewed

rule_wording.line: NF-7.6	A reversed deduction is repaid as a positive adjustment on a later remittance, referencing the original deduction	Claim, Vet
rule_wording.catalogue: A reversed deduction is repaid on a later remittance, referencing the original deduction

rule_wording.line: NF-10.2	On prepaid freight the supplier files loss or damage claims with its carrier: at least 9 months to file, 2 years to sue from written disallowance	Claim
rule_wording.catalogue: On prepaid freight the supplier files loss or damage claims with its carrier: at least 9 months to file and 2 years to sue

rule_wording.line: NF-8.2	In full: cases received against cases ordered per PO line, against the PO revision current at shipment. A cancelled remainder counts as not received	Nort
rule_wording.catalogue: In full: cases received against cases ordered per PO line, on the PO revision current at shipment; a cancelled remainder counts as not received

rule_wording.line: NF-8.6	Measured monthly; rolling 13-week scorecard; OT01 and OT02 billed quarterly	Northfield	Retailer-confirmed
rule_wording.catalogue: Measured monthly on a rolling 13-week scorecard; OT01 and OT02 are billed quarterly

rule_wording.line: NF-9.2	Below an OTIF target two months running: agree a corrective action plan within 30 days	Northfield	Retailer-confirmed
rule_wording.catalogue: Below a target two months running: agree a corrective action plan within 30 days
